industry: Information Technology > IT - Services > IT Enabled Services

operating_notes.text: Datamatics expanded client relationship with an American insurtech firm to cover claims, collections, and underwriting.
FY26 exceptional item of ₹64.87 Cr is the labour-code gratuity and leave-encashment impact; the company continues to monitor finalisation of Central/State Rules.

Step-down subsidiary with preference shares of ₹11.51 Cr and perpetual debentures of ₹36.14 Cr had negative net worth of ₹26.47 Cr as on March 31, 2025; management expects a turnaround and has made no provision.
Merger of Dextara Digital (USA) Inc. with Datamatics Global Services Inc. filed in Delaware, USA on January 29, 2025 is under process.
FY26 revenue grew 15.3% YoY to ₹1,987.2 crore while EBITDA expanded 62.1% YoY to ₹371.6 crore.
Secured contract with SBI Life Insurance for TruAI Underwriting solution powered by Agentic AI.

timeline.summary: Datamatics expanded its client engagement with an American insurtech firm to provide AI-led operations across underwriting, claims, and collections.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹519.26 Cr (+4.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹44.21 Cr (-1.4% YoY).
Datamatics reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,987.2 Cr and EBITDA of ₹371.6 Cr, recommending a final dividend of ₹5 per share.
Datamatics Global Services Ltd. shared the audio recording of its May 22, 2026, earnings call for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on its investor relations website.
On May 27, 2026, Datamatics announced that SBI Life Insurance selected its TruAI Underwriting solution powered by Agentic AI.
On May 28, 2026, Datamatics Global Services submitted the transcript link for its Q4FY26 earnings call held on May 22, 2026.
Dr. Lalit Surajmal Kanodia, as promoter, declared no encumbrance on Datamatics Global Services Limited shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend of ₹5 per share at the ensuing AGM
NCLT, shareholder and creditor approvals for the scheme of amalgamation
Member approval by postal ballot for appointment of Hitesh Gajaria and Navnit Singh as independent directors
Member approval for re-appointment of Rahul L. Kanodia as Vice Chairman & CEO from February 22, 2027
